caption: The drawing displays a quilt-like pattern composed of hexagonal shapes, arranged in a grid format. The background hexagons are primarily a light beige or cream color, while clusters of colored hexagons form distinct flower-like or geometric patterns within the grid. These clusters feature a variety of colors and patterns: the top row includes green and red patterned hexagons; underneath, there are red hexagons with floral motifs and a group of deep red ones with two white tulip-like shapes and small decorative elements. Towards the left, a cluster of blue hexagons with white-and-blue plaid and a brown center is visible. Moving downward, there is a group of dull pink patterned hexagons, with a center composed of a deeper pink and brown, surrounded by more beige hexagons. In the middle section, a prominent black hexagonal cluster contains red dots and a central band of red and white stripes with a small black motif. Below that, there is a pink group with darker pink details in a flowery pattern. On the bottom right, a black, gray, and white flower-like formation surrounds a dark pink central hexagon, featuring a striped design with red dots. All designs are bordered by the same beige hexagons, creating a symmetrical and repetitive composition. The drawing is set within a rectangular frame with a white border, and the artist's name, "Ruth M. Barnes," is signed at the bottom right.
title: Quilt (1 Section)
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
